newsitem.title: USA: Liberty Property closes 7.5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Property closes 7.5 mln shr offer.

text.p: Real estate investment trust Liberty Property Trust said it closed a public offering of 7.5 million common shares of beneficial interest at $24.50 per share.
Net proceeds to the company would be about $173.9 million before an overallotment option, Liberty said.
Lehman Brothers, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc, Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc and Wheat First Butcher Singer acted as underwriters, it said.
They had a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to an additional 1.13 million common shares, the company said.
